rationale: Stiven's work on AI-powered surgical navigation at Braillic involves embedded systems, computer vision, and real-time 3D guidance — domains where hardware validation and testing are critical for FDA clearance. Parth's hands-on experience in mechanical and hardware testing for complex robotics systems at Tesla could offer valuable perspective on the engineering rigor and test protocols needed to validate ArNav's hardware integration as Braillic scales toward commercialization.
intro_message: Stiven Ding, meet Parth Behani — your experience validating hardware systems for robotics could inform how Braillic tests and de-risks its AR surgical platform before FDA submission.
